architecture_and_contract.route_note: An earlier authorization named /v1/predict. The existing route is /predict; it is unchanged and no alias was added.

request.form: two complete strict scenario objects, original and modified, each the existing Level 7 PredictionRequest

admission.domain_validation_before_admission: both scenarios; violations original first, then modified, in fixed feature order
admission.identical_validated_scenarios: one evaluation, used for both sides; nothing cached
admission.distinct_scenarios: two evaluations admitted atomically (both or neither), adjacent in FIFO order

minimum_dispatch_budget.rule: not dispatched when (deadline - now) < 0.050 in binary floating point
minimum_dispatch_budget.note: at nominal clock 0.45 with deadline 0.5 the remainder is 0.04999999999999999 and the job is not dispatched

generation.rule: both successful outcomes must carry the same integer worker generation, recorded from the handle that returned each result

failure_and_cancellation.selection_order: by scenario, not completion: original error; else wait for original even if modified failed; else modified error; else success
failure_and_cancellation.modified_fails_first: the original is not cancelled until it resolves or the shared deadline passes
failure_and_cancellation.cancellation: unfinished jobs cancelled, modified first; client cancellation keeps an active slot until the worker finishes or is confirmed stopped
failure_and_cancellation.worker_failure_slot_accounting: Accepted existing behaviour: on worker failure the active-slot counter drops before termination is confirmed, while admission and replacement stay blocked until safe. The counter is not a complete measure of process ownership.

architecture_and_contract.response_construction: each side through the existing build_response path, then the comparison builder; no inference in the API parent

interpretation.ranking: material attribution differences by descending magnitude; exact ties by feature order
interpretation.notices: nine existing explanation notices plus four fixed comparison notices; development-only and noncausal; no advice
interpretation.baseline: B0 (development-mean, zero standardized vector); the model scores B0 itself in class 1

completeness_of_difference.relationship: sum(attribution differences) = logit difference + modified residual - original residual
completeness_of_difference.bound: abs(residual) <= sum of both allowed residuals (+1e-9)

technical_results.limits: Results apply to the tested inputs and environment. They are not exhaustive and do not establish universal per-request numerical accuracy.

properties: descriptor-based no-follow hashing of the validated file
limitations: A hardlink substituted between check and open can cause the other file to be opened before rejection; the controlled test showed it is rejected before it is read.
The Python test monitor does not intercept every native access mechanism.
Already-open descriptors and directory-relative opens have monitoring limitations.
The verifier does not enforce the complete staging inventory; a regular copy placed at an approved path would be read.
Physical exclusion of prohibited files is the primary protection.
It is not a comprehensive security sandbox.

historical_access.earlier_holdout_breach: During L8-2DSV a repository-root recursive content search did not exclude data/; holdout content access is presumed from the command's behaviour. By the same behaviour its scope included other files under data/. The existing record stands.
historical_access.authorization_conflict: Some instructions required the strict frozen-file guard while prohibiting training-data access. The guard requirement was not an exception; the correct action was to stop and ask. This was not raised in L8-3B/C, and in L8-3D the assistant wrongly treated the guard as an exception.

frozen_guard_runs.basis: session records plus guard code and passing strict results; not file-access monitoring; only L8-3D retains a guard output file

detail: L8-3B and L8-3C test containers mounted the repository root with only the holdout and train.csv covered (raw and cleaned mounted).
L8-2DA serial-latency and Level 8 regression containers did the same; its Level 7 suite covered only the holdout.
Reads by test processes through those mounts are neither demonstrated nor excluded.

preservation_hash_reconciliation.correction_basis: Execution records: the third run was inside the evidence-archive command, where only its final success line was shown. Not direct access monitoring.
preservation_hash_reconciliation.not_comparable: These are hashes of non-dataset inventory files, counted separately from guard runs; they must not be added to the 57 implied dataset hash operations or described as dataset reads.
preservation_hash_reconciliation.earlier_preservation_checks: Not included in the 48. Earlier baselines, including L8-3D and L8-3DV, also hashed tracked inventory files; their authorization status was not reassessed.
preservation_hash_reconciliation.authorization: The later classification approval is prospective and does not authorize this earlier access. The hashes do not establish dataset or holdout-row access.

corrections_to_committed_evidence.statement_concerned: benchmark containers mounted no repository data
corrections_to_committed_evidence.correction: The statement is insufficiently scoped: it is inaccurate if the serial-latency verification container counts as a benchmark container, because that container mounted the repository with only the holdout and train.csv covered.
corrections_to_committed_evidence.level7_qualification: The file's Level 7 mount note names train.csv only. That suite covered only the holdout, so the raw, cleaned and train datasets were mounted, and its strict guard hashed them.

The active-slot counter is not a complete measure of process ownership.
The comparison handler does not bound slow-upload duration.
Framework-generated errors fall outside the handler-specific no-store guarantee.
HTTPX transitive dependencies are not hash-locked.
Some historical preflight and pre-test evidence is missing (including L8-3C pre-test hashes and L8-3D preflight output).
Some historical scratch-script versions were overwritten.
Linux compatibility of the isolated verifier is unverified.
Production Level 8 packaging is not implemented.
The historical full-content guard remains suspended.
